claim: After a morning training session, cold showers came up with a few friends; a couple don't take them and asked why. The answer: a lot of physical benefits; personally the biggest direct impact is mental, on mind and emotions all day. But the biggest benefit, a key reason it has long been an all-the-time thing, is that personally it is a trickle-down habit
Trickle-down habits: the little things you do most or all days (personal care, family life, eating, driving) add up to a pretty large number
Some habits obviously have more direct impact, but more than that, habits differ in how they trigger other habits
The Pareto principle, or 80/20 rule, basically says 20% of your actions deliver 80% of the results, so the other 80% only deliver 20%: a lot of what we do doesn't move the needle that much
The Pareto principle, or 80/20 rule, applies to everything from cheese from cows in Wisconsin to businesses to economies, and certainly to our personal life
There's another level to the 80/20 rule: apply 80/20 again to that 20%, and 20% of it again gives 80% of the results, layer by layer
By the 80/20 rule, a very small number of habits trigger or trickle down to lots of other things occurring or not: a very small number of levers, working both ways equally, positive and negative
A huge part of improving, especially for lasting and meaningful transformations, is identifying and dialing in your trickle-down habits
You very likely have at least a couple of trickle-down habits at work now, maybe unaware
You may have a positive one, two, three or four that you know are trickle-down habits, leading to other good things
Once a cold shower is knocked out, the day unfolds differently, known from testing it; the difference is so huge that it's been a cold shower every single day for years
There are tons of examples of trickle-down habits, some quite common with a lot of guys and humans, some particular to you
One reason porn is so devastating for guys often is that it is a major negative trickle-down habit, changing downstream things for hours, even days

Often, as a negative trickle-down habit: you look at porn, masturbate, ejaculate, are filled with shame and wish you hadn't done it; or maybe not filled with shame, maybe not even aware of it yet, but you feel different, energy and confidence dragging
Often, after porn, next morning you get up later and skip the workout; next afternoon you're kind of down and have that beer; a couple of beers mean bed later and waking later
Porn as a negative trickle-down habit plays out in so many ways, including with your girlfriend, wife or partner
